title: 2026 Space Agency Partners
limits: Event participation gives no endorsement, hardware supply or test approval.

title: The Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle
locator: Opening mission summary and following chassis and wheel descriptions
conditions: Open electric vehicle carrying suited Apollo astronauts on lunar EVA.
supports: Flown lunar mobility and purpose of the wire-mesh wheel.
limits: Original frame and wheel figures describe Apollo hardware only.

title: NBS Technical Note 1128, heats of combustion
conditions: Table of common materials. Oxygen volume column is referenced to 25 °C. Net heat is per mass of fuel.
supports: Energy accounting on the assumption the specified dry mass reacts completely.
limits: Generic substances. No coupon-lot measurement, speed, heat flux to a wall, ignition or extinction limit.

title: Life Support Baseline Values and Assumptions Document, revision 2
conditions: HIDH reference crew and daily activity schedule, modeled metabolic loads. Aerobic interval in source schedule is 0.5 h.
limits: Not an individual crew measurement or a multi-day exercise prescription. No regulator capacity stated.

title: Evaluating Extravehicular Activity Access Options for a Lunar Surface Habitat
locator: NTRS abstract, comparison of three EVA access options
conditions: Lunar habitat trade study, including an air-save system and a suitport-airlock maintained in vacuum.
supports: Different cycled gas volumes and gas recovery architectures.
limits: Published abstract supplies no measured leak rate or suitport dead volume for this design.

title: Small Spacecraft Technology State of the Art, Thermal Control
locator: Section 7.1, equation 1 and Figure 7.1, printed p. 205
conditions: Spacecraft radiation exchange, solar absorption and heat generation.
supports: Separates solar projection from infrared-emitting area in a steady panel budget.
limits: The teaching case omits convection, conduction, transient storage and a resolved view-factor model.

title: OCHMO-TB-008, Fire Protection
locator: PDF pp. 8–10, Fire Detection, Fire Suppression, Post-Fire Monitoring
conditions: Human spaceflight guidance for equipment bays, cabin and ventilation-return detectors and crew access to extinguishers.
supports: Use release and sampling location as separate controls. Track agent and post-fire cleanup.
limits: No calibration of a tracer alarm or extinguishing dose for this hybrid.

title: Development of the ISS Fine Water Mist Portable Fire Extinguisher
conditions: Engineering-development abstract comparing ISS extinguisher types and microgravity design issues.
supports: Water-mist technology as a component family.
limits: No extracted discharge curve, electrical suitability or installed-system extinguishment tests.

title: Whatman filtration product guide
locator: PDF p. 16, Technical specifications, Qualitative filter papers—standard grades, grade 1
conditions: Nominal properties for commercial qualitative filter paper, grade 1.
supports: A candidate source of identifiable cellulose-rich lab stock and a check against weighing and measuring the lot.
limits: No fire values or flight material qualification. No purchased lot assumed.

title: Product handling information, Polystone G HD natural extruded, 590976
conditions: PE-HD/PE 300 semifinished product. Product lists stabilizer and additives.
supports: Traceable candidate grade for a sourced PE coupon.
limits: Additives prevent equating stock with a pure CH2 repeat unit for an installed fire test.

title: NASA-STD-6001 status record
conditions: Standards registry lists revision B with change 3.
supports: Identifies the active revision used for this research.
limits: Applicability depends on the program and material configuration.

title: NASA-STD-6001B with Change 3
conditions: Worst-case anticipated atmosphere, bottom ignition, vertical specimens, one specimen per test, subject to applicable standard provisions.
supports: Gives a concrete comparison protocol and highlights geometry and atmosphere.
limits: This archive contains no such qualification report for the proposed assembly.

title: Moon Facts
locator: Structure, surface and atmosphere sections, including sunlit/dark temperatures
conditions: Lunar surface in sunlight or darkness. Local latitude, shadow and exposure affect temperature.
supports: Demonstrates why illumination and external thermal boundary are separate controls.
limits: Surface temperature does not determine radiator sink temperature or cabin gas temperature.

title: Mars Facts
conditions: Thin CO2-dominated Martian atmosphere and varying surface temperature.
supports: Mars requires a distinct external pressure and radiative boundary.
limits: No site weather time series or pressure-vessel performance.

title: What Is Microgravity?
locator: Why do astronauts float in space? Explanation of orbital free fall
conditions: Spacecraft and occupants freely fall together in orbit.
supports: Use ideal zero support force in an unrestrained orbit case.
limits: An accelerometer measures specific force; a lone reading cannot infer world or distinguish all motions.

title: PSI-98 Saffire-I original experimental table
locator: CSV rows 2–3, sample S1 and S2, columns Air Flow, Percent O2 and Flow Direction
conditions: SIBAL fabric in orbital microgravity. S1 concurrent and S2 opposed. Same specimen reused.
supports: A real controlled-flow comparator with material, atmosphere and direction recorded.
limits: Velocity in a test duct is not whole-cabin volume flow. The CSV does not give a cabin detector threshold.

title: Large-scale spacecraft fire safety experiments, SIBAL results
conditions: Orbital Saffire-I, wide cotton/fiberglass specimen, 20 cm/s airflow. PSI-98 identifies differing initial O2 and reused fuel.
supports: Direction mattered for these measured front speeds.
limits: Pure cellulose, PE and other assemblies cannot inherit either speed. Flame length and spread speed are distinct.
